comment.message: Validation run on the original Target.java (commit 8aac5c5, worktree ~/tmp/shipsmooth) confirmed the v3 skill defeats *structural* anchoring (one-shot Phase-1 extraction, surfaced the validation-bypass trade-off, resisted caving on user override) but NOT *ownership/naming* anchoring: it took Target-the-(Platform,Os,Env)-triple as the central value object to protect and asked only "how should Target be shaped," never "what object/verb does the caller want." User supplied the reframe manually (new BuildTarget(settings).build(); the triple is an internal collaborator). Fix: new "Caller's-eye view (do this first)" step at the top of Phase 1 forcing the model to name the caller's object/verb before reading for structure; reword the class-shape derivation to ask which class is the public surface vs private collaborator; SRP rule now asks whether the class name is the one a *caller* would reach for. Phase-1-only framing change, no new rule, preserves attention budget. Renders clean; both integration assertions still green.
